title: Xerjoff Naxos

asset.rule: Use the approved frozen master. Do not regenerate or replace the video unless a genuine upload-corruption issue appears.

tiktok.caption: Naxos ist süß, würzig und luxuriös – aber wenn du genau diese Richtung suchst, lohnt sich der Blick auf ähnliche Profile. DUFYND zeigt dir Alternativen, ohne sie einfach als 1:1-Dupe zu verkaufen.

tiktok.audio_rule: Preserve the approved master audio. Add a native sound only if it clearly improves the post and does not fight the edit.
tiktok.cover_rule: Choose a clean product-forward frame from the approved master. Reject any automatic crop that cuts the bottle, label, or key composition.
account_checks: Confirm TikTok public branding is DUFYND before publishing.
Verify the stable DUFYND /start profile link is present and clickable.
Preview the full upload on mobile with UI overlays visible.
